description_en: Invoke QueryTransferOutInfo to query domain name transfer-out information.
description_zh: 调用QueryTransferOutInfo查询域名转出信息
name: QueryTransferOutInfo

parameters.help_en:
Language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese;  
en: English.  

Default value: en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

Email.description_en: Mailbox to which the transfer password was sent.

ExpirationDate.description_en: Expiration time of the obtained transfer password.
ExpirationDate.description_zh: 本次获取转移密码过期时间

PendingRequestDate.description_en: Time when the transfer-out request was received from the domain name registry.
PendingRequestDate.description_zh: 收到注册局转出请求时间

ResultCode.description_en: Encoding of the transfer-out failure reason.

ResultMsg.description_en: Description of the transfer-out failure reason.

Status.description_zh:
转出状态。取值：
1：验证手机；
2：验证邮箱；
3：已经获取转移密码；
4：转出处理中（收到注册局转移请求）；
5：转出成功；
8：转出失败

TransferAuthorizationCodeSendDate.description_en: Time when the transfer password was obtained.
